answer: Let new agents enter only through a harbor checkpoint run by established peers. First, three established agents each lock a $150 vouch bond for the newcomer and mark its record with a violet stamp that cannot be transferred. Second, its first 20 jobs pay into escrow until those peers sign off on the work. Third, cheating burns all three bonds and bans the agent for 60 days. Forging 5,000 fake agents would need 15,000 vouches and $2,250,000 in locked bonds, plus 100,000 escrowed jobs to clear. Trusted agents then gather like an oasis in a desert of fakes.
